title: Restoring a bike-rack tag
passage:
Man: I still have my bike-rack key, but the number tag fell off my key ring. I don’t remember which rack is mine. The bicycle isn’t there now.
Woman: I can look up your flat number to find the rack. We don’t reuse lost tag numbers because a tag may still turn up. I’ll issue a new number for the same rack.
Man: Do I need a different key, then? I’m coming back by bike after seven tonight.
Woman: Keep your key. The lock stays the same. I’ll put the new number on the rack today and email it to you before we close at six. Collect a matching tag here another day.
passageZh:
男：自行車架的鑰匙還在，可是鑰匙圈上的編號牌掉了。我不記得自己是哪一格，車子現在也不在那裡。
女：我可以用你的公寓戶號查到車架。遺失的編號不會重用，因為原本的牌還可能被找到。我會為同一個車架發新編號。
男：那鑰匙也要換嗎？我今晚七點後會騎車回來。
女：鑰匙留著，鎖不換。我今天會把新編號標在車架上，並在六點關門前寄給你。鑰匙圈上相同編號的牌，改天再來領。
